label: M26 Evidence Coverage Census & Oracle Gap — M25 28-case development set (run m26_20261016)
note: Production code untouched (HEAD 4ed8d4e). Reader frozen (qwen2.5:7b-instruct, temp 0.0, seed 42, max 256). Scorer frozen, never edited. 553-question holdout not touched.
interpretation: EAR=1.0 and ER=1.0 mean evidence acquisition is COMPLETE for all 28 cases. L1/L2/L3 = 28/28 mean the evidence is present in the original conversation, retained in memory, and delivered to the reader. L4 = 0/28 means that even GIVEN the verified supportive evidence (oracle condition), the frozen qwen2.5:7b-instruct reader cannot solve any of the 28. So the bottleneck is the reader side (L4), not evidence acquisition (L1-L3). oracle_gap=0.0 means normal and oracle conditions are equally bad — there is no deliverable gain to extract from the evidence chain. Conclusion: the improvement target moves from 'how to fetch evidence' to 'how to present evidence + reader capability' — candidate priorities: (a) evidence presentation / context construction, (b) reader model, (c) temporal resolution.
